{{ux|en|a question '''sleeps''' for the present; the law '''sleeps'''}} #* {{RQ:Shakespeare Merchant of Venice|act=V|scene=i|page=182|column=2|passage=How ſweet the moone-light '''ſleepes''' vpon this
